question: Who is the daughter-in-law of the supreme goddess and what is her role in awakening all mantras?
premises: The supreme goddess is the vīrapatnī.
inference: Thus the Kula lineage's daughter-in-law is the world-lady who awakens all mantras.
uncertainties: Exact internal sandhi and compound boundaries are inferred from the surface form.
plain_english: That daughter-in-law is the lady of the worlds, the awakener of all mantras.
